text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Rudolf... I know what you want. Let's do 
this—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Bringin' out the birthday happi coat!" 
"Stockin' up on beef tongue for the big 
day!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, what about my celebration?!" "This 
is way too much celebration!" "Seize the 
day and celebrate away!!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—How was that?! A hand-picked selection of 
birthday puns!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent...! Truly a collection of 
sparkling gems. To think I would be 
presented with something this splendid!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It happens every year, yet she never gets 
tired of it~ She loves it more than 
anything else. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
All that hard work coming up with pun 
ideas night after night really paid off, 
Ace!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Wha...! A pun on 'seeds' of a pun and 
'see, d'it work'...!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And you combined 'Shi-knight' with 'night 
after night'?! C.B., you really are 
incredible!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A true mentor and beneficial friend— From 
your running to your words, you are so 
free... I cannot help but feel envious, 
C.B.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever... As long as they're 
happy, it's fine.
